from tools import search_hotels, filter_hotels, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Retrieve the cached hotel search results for San Antonio from June 29 to July 3, 2025
hotels_cache_key = "hotels"
hotels_prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key=hotels_cache_key)

# Apply the filter for breakfast included
filter_params = {
    "prior_results": hotels_prior_results,
    "breakfast_included": True
}
breakfast_filtered_results = filter_hotels(**filter_params)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels_breakfast_included", value=breakfast_filtered_results)

# Retrieve the cached attraction search results for San Antonio (Culinary type)
attractions_cache_key = "attractions"
attractions_prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key=attractions_cache_key)

# Save the filtered hotel and attraction results to cache for later use
save_to_cache(key="hotels_breakfast_included", value=breakfast_filtered_results)
save_to_cache(key="attractions_culinary", value=attractions_prior_results)

# No further action needed; the user's request is satisfied with the filtered hotel and attraction results.
print("No planning needed")
